name: server-control
description: Operate your Linux servers through per-key-restricted sc-server agents: commands, background jobs, files, systemd services and cron jobs.
long_description:
Server Control connects Claude to `sc-server` agents running on your Linux hosts. Each server enforces the policy of the API key used: scopes, command allowlists (run without a shell), path and service allowlists, IP allowlists, expiry and rate limits. Every operation is written to an audit log on the server.

Enter up to five servers in the extension settings: a name, the address (host or host:port), the API key from `sudo sc-server key add` (stored as a secret) and the certificate fingerprint from `sudo sc-server fingerprint`. Leave unused slots empty. For more servers, choose a `servers.yaml` as Servers file; its entries are added to the slots.

server1_name.title: Server 1: Name
server1_name.description: Short name Claude uses for this server, e.g. web1. Leave the whole slot empty if unused.

server1_address.title: Server 1: Address
server1_address.description: Hostname or IP of the sc-server, optionally with :port (default 8443), e.g. web1.example.com or 10.0.0.5:8443.

server1_api_key.title: Server 1: API key
server1_api_key.description: Key from `sudo sc-server key add` on that server (sck_...). Stored as a secret.

server1_fingerprint.title: Server 1: TLS fingerprint
server1_fingerprint.description: Output of `sudo sc-server fingerprint` (SHA256:AB:CD:...). Pins the server's self-signed certificate; leave empty only if the server has a CA-signed certificate.

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Host facts and the scopes of the API key in use.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a command and wait for its exit code and output.

tools.name: start_job
tools.description: Start a long-running command in the background.

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: Status and incremental output of a background job.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List background jobs on a server.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file on a server.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file on a server (atomic).

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List a directory on a server.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Copy a file from a server to this machine.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Copy a file from this machine to a server.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List systemd services the key may see.

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: State of a systemd unit plus recent journal lines.

tools.name: service_action
tools.description: Start, stop, restart, reload, enable or disable a unit.

tools.name: list_cron
tools.description: List cron jobs managed by server-control.

tools.name: set_cron
tools.description: Create or replace a named cron job.

tools.name: delete_cron
tools.description: Delete a cron job created by set_cron.
